questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

A book market / was been operated by some readers / in the street when / they reached there.

options.text: was been operated by some readers

questions.solution:
The erroneous part is option 3) i.e. 'was been operated by some readers.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part 'was been operated by some readers.'
 
• Let's look at the structure of passive voice in the **past continuous tense**: Object + was/were + being + past participle (V3) + (by + subject) (Passive Voice) 
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• *He told me that the things **were being arranged** by Disha.*
 
 
 
• Thus,** 'been'** should be replaced by** 'being'**.
 
• Therefore in the given sentence, we need to use 'was being operated' in place of 'was been operated' to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

 

Correct sentence:__* A book market **was being operated by some readers** in the street when they reached there.*

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Somebody is following us.

options.text: We have been following by somebody.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option ) i.e. 'We’re being followed by somebody.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice. We have to change the sentence into passive form. 
 
• The given sentence is written in 'present continuous tense.'
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentences is:
 
 
• Active Voice: Sub + is/am/are + V1+ ing + obj
 
• Passive Voice: Obj + is/am/are + being + V3 + by (preposition) + Subject.
 
 
 
• Let’s see another example:
 
 
• Active voice: I am calling the cab driver.
 
• Passive voice: The cab driver is being called by me.
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'Somebody' and the object of the given sentence is 'us'. 
 
• So, in the passive voice, the position of ‘subject’ and ‘object’ will be interchanged. 
 
• 'us' will be changed into 'We'.
 
• Also here, 'is following' will be changed into 'are being followed'.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *We’re being followed by somebody.*

questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labeled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

P. The division was usually based on temperature, which allows for different vegetation growth.

Q. Köppen’s map used different colors and shades to represent the different climate zones of the world.

R. Wladimir Köppen developed a climate classification system at the end of the 19th century.

S. The system divides the world into five climate zones.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. "RSPQ." 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• Sentence R is the first sentence as it begins with the **noun 'Wladimir Köppen'. **It begins with introducing Wladimir Köppen and his work.

 It informs the reader that Köppen developed a climate classification system.
 
• Sentence S is the second sentence as it begins with the **noun 'The system'** and explains the basic functioning of the climate classification system. It informs the reader that the system divides the world into five climate zones. Thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 1.
 
• Sentence P is the third sentence as it begins with the **noun 'The division'**** **and provides additional details about the system. It explains that the division is usually based on temperature, which affects vegetation growth.
 
• Sentence Q is the last sentence as it begins with the noun **'****Köppen’s map**' and describes how Köppen's map represents the different climate zones of the world and uses different colours and shades to represent the various zones. Thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 1.

 

The correct order is:__ 

**R. **Wladimir Köppen developed a climate classification system at the end of the 19th century.

**S.** The system divides the world into five climate zones.

**P.** The division was usually based on temperature, which allows for different vegetation growth.

**Q.** Köppen’s map used different colors and shades to represent the different climate zones of the world.

questions.question:
**Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.**

The doctor said that they had performed their bit.

options.text: The doctor said, “We will be performing our bit."
The doctor said, “We are performing our bit."
The doctor said, “We have performed our bit."
The doctor says, “We had performed our bit."

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. The doctor said, “We have performed our bit."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Indirect Speech.** As per the given directions, we have to change it into **Direct Speech**.
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be removed and comma and inverted commas will be added.
 
• In the direct speech 'said' will not be changed because reporting verb has no object.
 
• The direct speech will begin like 'The doctor said.'
 
• Now, let's focus on the reported speech.
 
• The pronoun 'they' will be changed into 'We' and 'their' will be changed into 'our.'
 
• The past perfect tense 'had performed' will be changed into the present perfect tense 'have performed.'
 
• Finally, the result is: The doctor said, “We have performed our bit."
 
• ​So, the correct answer is option 3.

 

Correct Sentence:__* The doctor said, “We have performed our bit."*

questions.question:

• According to the rules of subject-verb agreement, a plural verb is used with a plural subject.
 
• Here, the subject **"Children"** is plural, so the verb should also be in the plural form **"listen"** instead of **"listens".**
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• ***​**His **children are** very precious to him.*
 
 
 
• Therefore in the given sentence, we need to use 'Children listen' in place of 'Children listens' to make the sentence grammatically correct.

Correct sentence:__* **Children listen to people** speaking around them for a long time before they begin to speak.*
